summary: Anvitam's organic discovery engine is technically top-tier with 16+ free calculators and zero-cost daily blogging. Key conversion bottlenecks are calculator-to-consultation CTA prompts and scaling high-DA reciprocal directory backlinks.

recommendations.title: Sticky Consultation Banner on Calculator Pages
recommendations.description: Users spending >90 seconds calculating rainwater harvesting or thermal mass need a 1-click CTA: 'Have Ar. Archana Gavas Review Your Exact Site Contours for ₹0'.

recommendations.title: FAQ Schema Builder with Structured Microdata
recommendations.description: Inject rich JSON-LD FAQ schema into all blog posts to capture Google AEO snippet and Gemini AI Overviews.

recommendations.title: Automated Drip Submission to 600 Free High-DA Directories
recommendations.description: Gradually submit 1-3 directories daily to build natural backlink velocity without triggering Google spam filters.

recommendations.title: Purge Stale Vercel Deployments Every 6 Days
recommendations.description: Prevent hitting Vercel's 100 deployment limit on the Free tier by auto-purging old preview builds.

recommendations.title: Enforce 24-Word Stop-Slop Filter on All Generated Content
recommendations.description: Ban em dashes and AI cliches like 'delve', 'tapestry', and 'furthermore' to keep AI detection score under 5%.

recommendations.title: Dispatch High-Net-Worth First 1,000 Client Drip via Resend
recommendations.description: Target luxury resort founders and tech CXOs with agricultural plots using personalized natural swimming pool and food forest unit economics.
